product.title: Controlled 1 m/pixel South Pole Average Mosaic
product.cite: Archinal et al. (2023), Controlled High-Resolution LROC NAC Polar Mosaics, LPSC 54, abstract 2333
product.wholeFileChecksumStatus: 8.28 GB tile not downloaded; only the byte ranges below

projection.axes: +x toward 90 E, +y toward 0 E (same as PGDA 78/90 GeoTIFFs)
projection.pixelRule: x = (sample-1) - SAMPLE_PROJECTION_OFFSET; y = LINE_PROJECTION_OFFSET - (line-1); pixel centres

window.rowOrder: row 0 = northmost (largest y), as in the source

display8bit.stretch: linear, 0.5-99.5 percentile of valid pixels -> 1..255; 0 = no data
display8bit.label: VISUAL: display stretch, not radiometry

limitations: Average of many NAC images under different Sun directions: not a real lighting state, and shading is baked in.
Never an input to horizons, rays, elevations or metrics.
Registration to the PGDA 78 5 m DEM is not guaranteed by either product; see the registration check in docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
Units of the averaged pixel value are not stated in the label read here; treated as relative brightness.
